notes.title: Anna's Summer Splash V2.0
notes.notes:
[b][u]Anna's Summer Splash V2.0[/u][/b]
This update is pretty big bringing the total number of sun metals from 43 to 60. With new challenges, mini games and levels. see the full list below.

This update contains:

[u][b]New features[/b][/u]
[u]-A new level.[/u]
The new level is Wave town, A sleepy port town.
[u]-A new fishing mini game.[/u]
Now when you clean the waters of an area fish will come back to the ecosystem and you can fish there.
[u]-The game room.[/u]
Now in the main Plaza there is the game room, if you find a game cartridge you can do a challenge. There are six challenges in total.
[u]-Character customization.[/u]
With 6 different out colors to choose from.
[u]-People in environment[/u]
When you clean the goo away from areas people will then populate the areas giving you new people to talk to.
[u]-10 Achievements.[/u]
[u]-Playstation controller support[/u]

[u][b]Changes to Anna's moves[/b][/u]
[u]-bubble move[/u]
Anna has a new bubble move to float up in the air and can attack in the bubble.
[u]-Water hover overheat[/u]
The water hover now moves up faster and uses less water but now can overheat.
[u]-Max water increased[/u]
Anna can now hold much more max water (from 120 now to 180)
[u]-Under water[/u]
Anna can now hold her breath for much longer (from 40s now to 60s)
[u]Anna has more voice lines[/u]
[u]-Some more improvements to wall jumping[/u]

[u][b]Graphical improvements[/b][/u]
[u]-A lot of texture changes[/u]
Mainly in the environment to give a 3D feel and on the Goobles.
[u]-New water effects[/u]
Anna will be dripping wet when she leaves water and when she jumps in water it makes a splash.
[u]-Better animations[/u]
Anna's jumping, running, and wall grabbing animations changed

[u][b]Boss improvement[/b][/u]
[u]-Bosses health[/u]
Most bosses has had their heath changed for balancing.
[u]-Stingray boss speed reduced[/u]
[u]-Boss laser beam attack now has an animation[/u]
[u]-Splash palace's boss has more visible attacks[/u]
[u]-Final boss hitbox changed[/u]

[u][b]Small changes[/b][/u]
[u]-Faster text speed.[/u]
[u]-More coins in all levels[/u]
[u]-If you fall out of the Sapphire cruise it won't kick you out of the level[/u]
[u]-Small map changes[/u]
[u]-the level order has changed for balancing and the first level is now unlocked at the start[/u]

notes.title: Anna's Summer Splash V1.2.0 Quality of life
notes.notes:
[u][b]Anna's Summer Splash V1.2.0[/b][/u]

[b]This update is mainly a Quality of life update with some bug fixes and small changes.[/b]

[u][b]Quality of life:[/b][/u]
-when you clear out all the goo in a level any remaining goobles will be defeated.
-A secret level sign will appear once you are able to enter the secret level in a stage.
-Platforms that disappear when you jump now have a ghost box to let you know where they are when they're not active.
-The game will now tell you if you don't have a save file for a save slot.
-The water burst attack has been buffed so that you can use it faster.
-Water barrels have been added to Splash Palace next to the boss.

[u][b]Bug fixes:[/b][/u]
-The bug where you paused the game with the start race UI is fixed.
-Gooble spawners and goo drippers interact with the players water attacks and touching them damages the player.

[u][b]Small changes:[/b][/u]
-The players UI is now animated.
-The red coin UI has been removed from the final boss.
-Small change to tutorial.

notes.title: update V1.1.2: New input options / bug fixes and quality of life.
notes.notes:
This is the V1.1.2 update:

Due to feedback I have added a New input options.
-You can now use right trigger to use the dash as an alternative button.
-You can now use left trigger to use the hover move as an alternative button.

Bug fixes and quality of life.
-Black bars no longer obscure view when playing on unintended aspect ratios.
-UI no longer shows red coins on secret levels.
-A new sound will play when you try to use water but have no water to use.

notes.title: update V1.1.0: Improved wall jump and final boss/ ending changes
notes.notes:
this is the V1.1.0 update:

Due to feedback I have improved the wall jump to convey more information to the player.
-Super jump star effect stops when wall jump initiated.
-Dust effect when sliding off of wall.
-Wall grab animation is more snappy.
-sound design for both grabbing onto the wall and sliding off of it.

Other changes.
-Other player animations have been slightly tweaked to feel better.
-In the final boss area more water has been added to the start of the area.
-Pillars have been added to the middle of the final boss arena to stand on.
-small changes of the ending.
